scenarios.prompt: A systemic puzzle allows several legal solutions from the same property table. Define a versioned legal solution policy and reset path.

criteria.identity: puzzle_id/revision and relevant state/property identities are explicit.
criteria.solutions: Legal solution policy and alternate-solution behavior are clear.
criteria.recovery: Fail/reset/leave and hint/accessibility policies are explicit and recoverable.
